name: media-modal-default
title: Media Modal Default
description: A two-up grid of media panels, one still image and one video, that each expand to a large view when clicked. The pair sits edge to edge in its container.
use: A pair of images or clips should preview small but be readable full size.
avoid: The demo hardcodes two remote media URLs and gives no captions or controls.
a11y: Panels are click targets with no labels or keyboard handling, and the media carries no captions. (keyboard: no, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Two rounded media panels side by side: a deep red scene with a glossy red disc-like object, and a blue scene with a green sponge-like object. One panel can grow to fill most of the frame while the other peeks out behind.
behaves: Clicking a panel grows it to a large single view while the other slides behind; clicking it again returns the pair. The right panel plays a looping video.
customise: The two media URLs are written in the file; swapping the image, the video or the pair needs a source edit.
weight: moderate: Two remote media panels with a streaming video and a layout animation.
demo: A red glossy 3D disc render and a green 3D sponge video on blue
issues: No captions or labels identify the two media items.
The enlarged panel leaves uneven black margins around the media.
polishWhy: Bold glossy media and a clean two-up grid; unlabeled panels and uneven expanded framing reduce it.
